summary: Kerb with houses 8 m away on the same side, next to a junction.
reasons: Homes line the whole west side

drivers.seclusion: Houses front this west kerb closely along its length, the nearest 8 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow verge beside a through road; a couple of cars stop at the south end but there is little room to clear the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a side-street junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars occasionally stop at the south end; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Open kerb; trees at the south end give some shade.
